title: [GMCP 203.008.02] Production path: Complete schemas, primitives, content, and metadata model
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-008-02. Implement the canonical state, types, and primary production path. Replace stubs, demo-only paths, duplicated semantics, and implicit ambient state; preserve compatible behavior through explicit adapters; and make the new path reachable from the shipped GMCP runtime. Vector outcome: Every MCP primitive and content variant is represented losslessly, including annotations, icons, resource links and embedded resources, binary media, extensions, cache scope/TTL, audience and priority metadata, and JSON Schema 2020-12 input/output contracts. Round-trip fixtures preserve unknown extension fields; schema limits, external-reference policy, Unicode, URI and MIME validation, and canonical serialization are exhaustively tested. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
